name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix, dialog domain (home file dialog.c), descriptor area_backup_buffer accurately reflects the dialog 'save under' snapshot it points to. No Ghidra address residue (no _53a71 suffix). The variable is a void* heap pointer rather than the buffer itself, but 'buffer' standing for 'buffer pointer' matches the established same-file sibling convention: data_fd2_portrait_sprite_buffer is also a heap pointer (uint8*) named without a _ptr suffix (only the array-of-pointers data_fd2_dialog_dialog_frame_layer_save_buffer_ptrs uses _ptrs). Renaming to add _ptr would break that local consistency for no correctness gain. Keep.
purpose: Single heap pointer (void*) holding the dialog 'save under' snapshot buffer: a 0x48x0x48 (5184-byte) framebuffer patch saved before an overlaid settings/status dialog is drawn so the hidden background can be repainted on close.
logic_summary: Written/read by exactly two accessors. fd2_backup_dialog_area_to_buffer (0x175A9) frees any prior buffer if non-NULL, sets this = malloc(0x1440), then copies 0x48 rows of 0x48 bytes from large_game_state_buffer+0x8088 anchored one tile up/left of the cursor (cursor_screen_x/y - 1; col stride 0x18, row stride 0x2AC0; working-buffer source row stride 0x1C8) into the malloc'd region. fd2_restore_dialog_area_from_buffer (0x17643) does the inverse memmove, reading this pointer as the source to repaint the cursor-corner background. Disasm confirms dword-ptr access (CMP [0x53a71],0x0 / PUSH dword ptr / MOV [..],EAX from malloc / MOV EDX,dword ptr base) -> 4-byte pointer.
element_semantics: A single 4-byte heap pointer to a malloc(0x1440)=5184-byte buffer holding a 0x48x0x48 8bpp pixel patch (1 byte per pixel) of the working framebuffer region under a dialog box; NULL when no snapshot is currently held.
notes: BSS (read_memory shows 64 zero bytes); zero-init at startup, no static initializer, consistent with the void* definition at dialog.c:1320. Existing def comment block (dialog.c:1305-1320) and the two per-function plates already describe the pointer accurately and ASCII-clean -> no src Edit, no Ghidra plate change. Both accessors are equivalence-clean memmove loops matching the vendor; no logic concerns.
